definitions.explanation: A Japanese manual therapy that aims to correct the alignment of the spine, joints, and pelvis through hands-on manipulation. Practiced in private studios called {整体院|せいたいいん}; not a formally licensed profession in Japan, unlike massage or judo therapy.

examples.japanese: {腰痛|ようつう}のため{整体|せいたい}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to a seitai clinic because of lower back pain.

examples.japanese: {骨盤|こつばん}の{歪|ゆが}みを{整体|せいたい}で{矯正|きょうせい}してもらった。
examples.english: I had the pelvic misalignment corrected with a seitai treatment.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{肩|かた}こりが、{月一回|つきいっかい}の{整体|せいたい}でだいぶ{楽|らく}になった。
examples.english: My years of shoulder stiffness have eased considerably thanks to monthly seitai sessions.

notes:
Compound of {整|せい} ("to arrange, align") + {体|たい} ("body"). Note that {整体|せいたい} is homophonous with {声帯|せいたい} (vocal cords) and {生態|せいたい} (ecology) — context disambiguates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整体|せいたい}に{通|かよ}う: to go to a seitai clinic regularly
- {整体|せいたい}を{受|う}ける: to get a seitai treatment
- {整体|せいたい}{師|し}: seitai practitioner
- {整体|せいたい}{院|いん}: seitai clinic
- {骨盤|こつばん}{矯正|きょうせい}{整体|せいたい}: pelvic-alignment seitai

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指圧|しあつ}: shiatsu — finger-pressure massage; licensed profession
- カイロプラクティック: chiropractic — Western adjustment system; similar in approach
- {整骨|せいこつ}/{接骨|せっこつ}: osteopathy/bonesetting — focuses on bone and joint injuries; nationally licensed
